items.text: EFU General Insurance Limited (“EFUG”) was incorporated in 1932 as a public limited company and is engaged in underwriting non-life insurance and window takaful business. The Company is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited, with its ownership structure, including the pattern and categories of shareholding, disclosed in detail in this Annual Report. Following the Government of Pakistan’s decision in 1990 to reopen the life insurance sector to the private sector, the EFU Group established EFU Life Assurance Limited (EFUL), which commenced operations in November 1992. EFU Life was the ﬁrst insurer in Pakistan to introduce unit-linked insurance products. In March 2018, the Board of Directors assessed the Company’s control over its investment in EFUL and declared EFUL to be a subsidiary of EFUG.
